title: okf-strategy — Concept frontmatter (OKF-Strategy profile v1.0)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a single OKF concept, for OKF-Strategy. Grounded in the real ClearPoint OpenAPI (cps-lucee/api/v1/doc/schema): the `cps` block is the portable, on-disk superset of ClearPoint's own AI-grounding projection (_mcpElement / _mcpElementStatus / _mcpLink). A conforming concept is ALSO a valid base-OKF concept — the only hard requirement is a non-empty `type`, and every extension lives under `cps`, so a base-OKF consumer ignores it. The five axes (structure, access, time, provenance, vocabulary) all live under `cps`.

type.description: Base-OKF required field. Human/canonical kind, e.g. 'Objective'. Machine-canonical type is cps.object; the organization's term for it is in glossary.md.

resource.description: Canonical URI: clearpoint://scorecard/<scorecardId>/<object>/<objectId>. Round-trip identity anchor. No tenant/district segment — a bundle is already district-scoped by the key that produced it.

tags.description: Base-OKF tags. ClearPoint tags project to STRINGS (see _mcpElement.tags). OKF-Strategy convention: namespace as '<dimension>:<value>' (e.g. 'theme:on-time', 'perspective:customer'). Tags are facets, NOT access.

timestamp.description: Base-OKF last-modified (SYSTEM time; maps to element.lastEdited/lastUpdated max). Reporting-period (VALID time) is in cps.time + body period sections.

cps.description: OKF-Strategy extension — superset of _mcpElement. A base-OKF consumer ignores this whole key.

objectId.description: AXIS 1. element.objectId; null before creation. Round-trip identity.

initiativeId.description: AXIS 1. Parent initiative for a milestone.

periodicity.description: AXIS 3 — reporting periodicity: the periodGroup NAME (e.g. 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Annual'). Its periods are grouped in the root periodicities.md lookup.

lookup.description: For a root lookup concept (type: Lookup): the lookup it holds. Its required table columns are SPEC §2.1.

profile.description: The OKF-Strategy profile version, <major>.<minor>. Carried by the root glossary.md (SPEC §9).

layoutResource.description: Bundle-relative path of the element's optional presentation data, data/layout-<hash>.json (SPEC §6.3).

access.description: AXIS 2 — Access. A REFERENCE tag, not the requesting user's level (the caller's effective access is deliberately NOT embedded). It names the concept's access boundary and any element-scoped exceptions; the full policy (principals, per-scorecard grants, group rules + memberships) lives in the portable user-access.md lookup. Enforcement is pre-retrieval, server-side, per principal — the bundle already contains only what the requesting user can see.

derivedFrom.description: The concept's access boundary — the resource URI of the scorecard (or parent, e.g. an initiative for a milestone) it inherits access from. Resolve against user-access.md for who-can-do-what.

rules.description: Element-scoped rule exceptions that target THIS concept (e.g. a group granted No Access to a specific measure). Broad, scorecard-level grants stay in user-access.md, not here.

markings.description: Optional compartment labels (e.g. 'scorecard:<id>', 'personal:<userId>'). Not emitted by the default ClearPoint producer, which uses derivedFrom + rules; reserved for derived/personal nodes.

status.description: AXIS 3 — Time/Status. The element's current reporting status + cadence. Bitemporal: grounding reads VALID time (reporting period); 'current' is PER-ELEMENT at its own cadence.

currentPeriod.description: Latest relevant reporting period (element.displayPeriodId / elementStatus.period), with its status snapshot. Narrative (analysis/recommendations) stays in the body period section.

statusResource.description: Bundle-relative path of the status history sidecar, data/<object>-<objectId>-status.json (SPEC §4.3.1). Omitted when no period has a status or narrative.

provenance.description: AXIS 4 — Provenance. EDITORIAL (native ClearPoint audit) + RESOLUTION (parse confidence).

lastUpdatedBy.description: Who last reported on the element: the stamp of the current period's status entry. Distinct from lastEditedBy.

resolved.description: Resolution: only on parsed/derived nodes — selector + confidence + evidence, or a ref.

measure.description: Series definitions and the sidecar pointer (SPEC §6). Any series-bearing element carries it: measure, initiative, milestone, actionItem, risk. A producer that keeps a non-measure's series on an internal helper object resolves it to the owning element.

dataResource.description: Bundle-relative path or URI of the full series sidecar (data/*).

evaluation.description: Evaluation rules in effect for this element (SPEC §6.2): per-series status bands for any series-bearing element, or bands plus weighted children for an objective. Omitted when evaluation is off.

derivation.description: How the source computes this series (SPEC §6.4). Omitted for entered values.

calculation.description: derivation formula: an expression over [<Concept ID>|missing][<series name>][<period selector>] references (SPEC §6.4).

scorecardScope.description: Scorecards a roll-up reads: all, the element's own, its immediate children, scorecardList, or those tagged scorecardTag.

aggregateDerivation.description: SPEC §6.4 aggregate: a roll-up of matching series across matching elements.

statusDerivation.description: SPEC §6.4 status: a count of matching elements whose status is one of statuses.

referenceDerivation.description: SPEC §6.4 reference: a field of an element read each period.

concept.description: Concept ID of the target; omitted means the series' own element.

customField.description: Custom field name when field is customField.

evaluation.description: SPEC §6.2. Series-bearing elements carry statusSeries / statusSeriesId and series[]; objectives carry bands[] and weights[].

enabled.description: True when the source evaluates this element automatically. A block is only emitted when true.

statusSeries.description: Name of the series whose status the element reports, or 'best' / 'worst' when statusSeriesId is -1 / -2.

statusSeriesId.description: Id of that series; -1 = best status across evaluated series, -2 = worst.

series.description: Each evaluated series with its ordered bands.

bands.description: Objective bands over the weighted average status score.

calculation.description: Threshold grammar (SPEC §6.2): a number or '=<number>' is a literal; '' is the reference value itself; any other string is an arithmetic suffix on the reference value; 'low,high' for btw.

sortOrder.description: Evaluation order; the first band that holds wins.

concept.description: The child's Concept ID when resolvable.

status.description: Resolved status name for this period (short; full narrative in the body).

personStamp.description: Who + when. `name` is the grounding-facing string (ClearPoint stores a userId; the emitter resolves it, as _mcpElement resolves owner).
